scenes.title: GROUP BY
scenes.narration: GROUP BY collapses rows into groups so aggregate functions can summarize each one.

scenes.title: Grouping rows
bullets: Bundles rows sharing a column value
Aggregates compute one result per group
scenes.narration: GROUP BY gathers rows that share the same value into a single group. Aggregate functions like COUNT and SUM then produce one summary result for each group. Any column in SELECT that is not aggregated must appear in the GROUP BY.

scenes.title: Sales per product
scenes.narration: GROUP BY bundles the order items so each product forms one group. SUM then adds the quantities within each group to give total units sold. The alias total_sold names that per-product figure in the output.

scenes.title: How grouping flows
scenes.narration: The query first filters rows with WHERE, then partitions the survivors into groups by the grouping column. Aggregate functions run once per group to summarize it. The result is a single row for each distinct group.

scenes.text: GROUP BY is the foundation of summarized reporting, turning many rows into per-group results.
scenes.narration: Use GROUP BY to summarize data into one row per category, and make sure every non-aggregated column in SELECT is also in the GROUP BY.
